name: Only in Passing
source:
That person on the train. That person in the café. That person whose gaze you meet for a moment...

These are the people you meet only in passing, then never to see again...

Catch a glimpse of the world through Emma Sea's eyes. And meet the people she meets. What will Emma encounter on her commute home?

[from [url=https://derpychocho.itch.io/only-in-passing]itch.io[/url]]

(Note: The game is only able to be played through once. It cannot be replayed once you quit or return to the main menu.)
translation:
火车上的那个人。咖啡馆里的那个人。那个与你目光一瞬间相遇的人……

这些人只是你路过时遇到的，然后就再也见不到了……

通过艾玛·西的眼睛一睹世界。并认识她遇到的人。艾玛在回家的路上会遇到什么？

[来自[url=https://derpychocho.itch.io/only-in-passing]itch.io[/url]]

（注：游戏只能玩一次，退出或返回主菜单后无法重玩。）
